headline: Termas dos Laranjais Plans R$ 300 Million Expansion Following R$ 260 Million Revenue
summary: Brazilian water park Termas dos Laranjais reported R$ 260 million in revenue and announced plans to invest over R$ 300 million in new attractions, a second park, and a hotel.
why: Large-scale leisure and tourism investments drive regional economic activity and consumer discretionary spending in the hospitality sector.
